limitations: Historical-only positive replacement. No2026 comparison or full-state anomaly qualification is asserted; current Chaves/CD2 candidate value remains protected/masked and held.

Official SOS-linked historical database CSV contains explicit COUNTY aggregates; these are read as published, without reconstructing or modifying any masked precinct value. Precinct rows are ignored. Source-masked precinct details remain masked in retained original.

CD1/CD2 historical county aggregates are independently checked against separately published source district controls, original stateCSV controls and all6 corresponding FEC controls; numeric CD3 original county API supplies both other controls.
Source write-in identities and parties are retained. VictoriaL.Gonzales Independent is Other; EliseoLuna Democratic is Democrat according to both official source surfaces, not assigned by inference.

Both full33-county historical and current geometry rosters are separately documented, but current protected cells prevent an exact full numeric state comparison. No percentage, remainder or zero is used to reconstruct them.
Election-global historical update time is a labeled reference, not a known county count-update or precise historical publication date.
Candidate-vote sums are not ballots cast, distinct voters or eligible-voter turnout. No outcome, misconduct or statistical anomaly conclusion is inferred.
